item.title: eWiz 0.19.2
item.description:
eWiz's controls no longer stop working after a plug or unplug sound fails

If the audio output changed at the wrong moment (headphones, a display's speakers), the plug or unplug sound could fail inside macOS's audio framework. eWiz didn't crash, but from then on every button, toggle and mode in the menu-bar panel did nothing until eWiz was restarted. A sound that fails is now skipped and eWiz carries on. This is the real fix for the unresponsive panel that 0.19.1 set out to fix by rebuilding the panel on each open.
